venture.name: Maple Loaf Bakery (hypothetical)
venture.summary: A fictional bakery used to illustrate a customer and growth handoff.
venture.customer: Households near a weekend market stall (hypothetical)

evidence_ledger.claim: Households within walking distance of the stall are the best first segment
evidence_ledger.label: ASSUMPTION
evidence_ledger.risk: If the first customers are not nearby households, the stall location and the flyer channel both miss.
evidence_ledger.validation: Ask 20 more neighbors and a sample of market visitors where they live and how they heard of the stall.

evidence_ledger.claim: Interviewees say fresh bread is hard to find on weekends
evidence_ledger.label: FOUNDER_PROVIDED
evidence_ledger.limitations: Eight neighbors chosen by the founder. They may agree more than typical customers, and the notes were not examined.

evidence_ledger.claim: Customers will pay $8 for a loaf
evidence_ledger.label: UNVERIFIED
evidence_ledger.risk: If customers will not pay $8 the margin per customer disappears.
evidence_ledger.validation: Take paid pre-orders at $8 from comparable customers and count them.

evidence_ledger.claim: Ingredient and packaging cost per loaf
evidence_ledger.label: FOUNDER_PROVIDED

evidence_ledger.claim: Customers the founder attributes to the flyer test
evidence_ledger.label: FOUNDER_PROVIDED

evidence_ledger.claim: Customers the founder attributes to the referral test
evidence_ledger.label: FOUNDER_PROVIDED
ASSUMPTION
evidence_ledger.validation: Replace with the amount the founder can actually spend.

evidence_ledger.claim: Channel comparison of the two tests
evidence_ledger.label: DERIVED
evidence_ledger.limitations: Two very small tests. A CAC from a small test may not hold at a larger budget, and attribution is the founder's own.

notes: The test cost nothing, so the budget does not limit customers here. Measure the real cost of the time or tools used.

open_questions: Do customers pay $8 when asked to commit money?
Does the flyer CAC hold at a larger budget?
next_steps: Repeat the flyer test with a larger spend and count the customers.
notes: Every figure and every interview result in this file is invented for documentation. A real handoff records only research the founder actually did.
